summary: generate_image's description now sends her to the image-generation skill before she calls it, instead of letting her draw from memory.
details: Fixes a live failure (2026-09-24, WhatsApp): asked to draw herself again, she called generate_image with no reference and a mascot description written from memory, drawing a different character.
The canonical reference handle and the appearance rules stay in the image-generation skill only; the tool text points at it rather than repeating it.
